("deliveries"."kind" = 'test') = ("deliveries"."digest_id" is null)
        and ("deliveries"."kind" = 'event') = ("deliveries"."event_id" is not null)
        and ("deliveries"."digest_id" is null) = ("deliveries"."position" is null)
